messages:
maya: Heads up — TelemetryCo sent a security bulletin claiming possible API token leakage in their ingestion service for Mar 10–12 window. We have an integration for telemetry ingest (non-prod + prod read-only). Link: https://telemetryco.example/incident-2026
kevin: Which TelemetryCo keys does Redwood have in prod vs staging? Do we store any long-lived secrets? @sam any inventory?
sam: Inventory: vault path secret/telemetryco (prod-read-only), secret/telemetryco-staging (staging-write). Prod key is scoped read-only and used by metrics-ingest. Staging key used by dev pipeline. See infra/secrets/README.
tj: I'm kicking off quick checks: vault access logs + S3 grep for any plaintext dumps. Will report in ~15.
sec-bot: [Automated] Vendor bulletin ingested: telemetryco_incident_2026_03 processed. Created triage thread #sec-telemetry-telemetryco-181234. Severity suggested: medium. :rotating_light:
maria: Immediate actions proposal:
- Rotate all TelemetryCo tokens (prod + staging) and revoke old tokens on TelemetryCo portal
- Force re-issue in Vault and update consumers
- Preserve evidence: copy affected S3 objects and CloudTrail/Stackdriver logs to WORM bucket
- Short-term RBAC: remove TelemetryCo service accounts from prod writing roles
We need legal + procurement on external comms.
procurement: Acknowledged. I'll request TelemetryCo's IOC list and ask for indicators of compromise and their token rotation plan.
kevin: Do we have any evidence of token use outside expected IP ranges? tj, can you query CloudTrail/Cloud Logging for TelemetryCo-related calls and KMS decrypt events?
tj: Quick grep in test artifacts: found a file in s3://redwood-dev-artifacts/telemetry/creds.txt that contains a TelemetryCo token placeholder (non-prod). Command run:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-dev-artifacts/telemetry/creds.txt - | sed -n '1,3p'
# telemetryco_token=REDACTED_PLACEHOLDER
```
No obvious prod leaks in that scan. Continuing broader search across buckets and repos (git grep 'telemetryco' --quiet).
sam: Good catch. For containment: rotate staging token ASAP. For prod, plan rotate during next maintenance window unless we see suspicious activity. Also enable short TTL on new tokens.
maria: TJ, run CloudTrail lookup for KMS Decrypt/Decrypt calls and TelemetryCo API calls in the Mar 8–14 window. Example command:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-08 --end-time 2026-03-14
```
Attach results to the thread.
kevin: Also check our SIEM for outbound connections to TelemetryCo hostnames from unexpected hosts.
procurement: TelemetryCo responded: they rotated a batch of compromised tokens and published a revocation list. They recommend customers rotate keys and verify signed webhook deliveries. Sharing vendor bulletin PDF in #vendors.
legal: Keep internal comms only. Do not notify customers yet until we have scope. If any customer data touched, we escalate.
maya: Status: tj found only dev artifact leak so far. We're rotating staging token now. Prod rotation scheduled + PR to infra to swap token via Vault once new token is issued. Creating JIRA: SEC-INC-2026-198.
sam: Quick KMS checklist I ran:
```
# list keys
aws kms list-keys --profile prod
# check last usage
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/telemetryco-prod
```
If KMS CMK used to encrypt tokens, check key policy for service accounts and rotate CMK if any misuse suspected.
tj: CloudTrail snippets: a handful of Decrypt events by service-account-dev between Mar 11 02:00–03:00 UTC. No Decrypt by prod service-account. Uploading log snapshots to WORM bucket.
maria: RBAC note: we've removed TelemetryCo write roles from prod ingestion group and added a temporary deny policy. Will revert after cleanup.
kevin: Prepare fallback: metrics-ingest can switch to local buffering + backfill from backup endpoint for up to 48h. I can enable feature flag if needed.
procurement: TelemetryCo provided IOCs and a signed statement. I'll validate signatures and forward to legal.
legal: Once you confirm no customer PII was sent to TelemetryCo during the window, we can prepare a short external customer notice template.
maya: Action items recap:
- tj: finish logs + SIEM search, attach artifacts (due 1h)
- sam: coordinate Vault rotation + new tokens (due 2h)
- maria: RBAC changes and evidence preservation (done/ongoing)
- procurement: validate vendor artifacts with legal (ongoing)
- kevin: prepare fallback enablement plan (standby)
I'll update execs after initial containment. :white_check_mark:
kevin: If anyone finds prod use of the compromised tokens, shout in #incidents and we'll escalate to P1.
maya: Thanks everyone — keeping channel open for updates.
